description_full:
PAID INTERNSHIP — EASYARCH

Easyarch is opening an internship opportunity for university students in architecture and interior design who are eager to develop skills, gain practical experience, and learn more about the architectural design process.

If you're curious about design, enjoy exploring ideas, and want to learn alongside our team, we'd love to hear from you!

📍 Work from Office — GIK UGM, Yogyakarta
🕔 Full-time Internship
📩 Send your CV & portfolio to hi@easyarch.id (max. 10 MB)

Subject: EA_INTERN_ARC/INT_NAME

🗓️ Submission deadline : 30 November 2026

Take the next step in your design journey with Easyarch. See you soon!👋
